title: Find a cleared alarm and how long it lasted
description: Clear an alarm from its component, then read it in the alarm page's Cleared filter with when it cleared and how long it was raised, and open its history.

steps.caption: The display has a High alarm, History demo input lost. Fix the fault, then clear it.
Clearing is a write, so the page goes into edit mode first.
Clear the alarm. The row is kept rather than deleted, under Recently cleared.
The component's own panel says how long it was raised.
The alarm page's Cleared filter is the fleet's history. The address carries the filter, so a link to it shows the same list.
Raised, when it cleared and how long it lasted, one row each. Sort by Duration to find the long ones.
Open the row for the same drawer the queue uses, with the alarm's history.
Its raise and its clear, with the time between them as Lasted.
